official_definition: Kagemusha - When your Spirit with Soul Core on it becomes the target of an opponent's effect, you can summon this Spirit card in your hand. Then, change the target of that effect to this Spirit only.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Kagemusha] or [Kagemusha: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Kagemusha]", "give [Kagemusha]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
